name: Cracker Spread
description: A simple and creamy cheese spread made with tomato soup and Kraft cheese, served with crackers.
recipeIngredient: 1 small size jar Kraft cheese spread

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the tomato soup, butter, and Kraft cheese spread.
Heat the mixture but do not boil. Stir constantly for 5 minutes.

keywords: cheese spread, cracker dip, party appetizer
